statements: The chair of Food Standards Scotland is appointed by the Scottish Ministers under section 6(1)(a) of the Food (Scotland) Act 2015.
The Food (Scotland) Act 2015 requires no approval or confirmation of the chair's appointment by the Scottish Parliament.
The Act fixes no term of office for the chair: under section 6(5) membership is for such period and on such terms and conditions as the Scottish Ministers may determine.

The appointment is a regulated public appointment under the Public Appointments and Public Bodies etc. (Scotland) Act 2003, so it is governed by the code of practice of the Commissioner for Ethical Standards in Public Life in Scotland, who may under section 2(8) direct the Ministers to delay the appointment, and the Ministers must comply.
